title: キャラクターや背景の崩れを抑えたい場合は、15秒クリップを繋ぎ合わせるよりSeedance 2.5で30秒を一括生成して連続ショットにする
content: キャラクターや背景の崩れを抑えたい場合は、15秒クリップを繋ぎ合わせるよりSeedance 2.5で30秒を一括生成して連続ショットにする
tips: キャラクターや背景の崩れを抑えたい場合は、15秒クリップを繋ぎ合わせるよりSeedance 2.5で30秒を一括生成して連続ショットにする

en.content:
If you want to minimize distortion in characters and backgrounds, it’s better to generate a continuous 30-second shot all at once with Seedance 2.5 rather than stitching together 15-second clips.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#capcutseedance25 #capcutcpp
Seedance 2.5 is now available in CapCut❣️
With AI videos, the longer they get, the more likely the characters and backgrounds are to break down.
So I tried using Seedance 2.5 to create a 30-second continuous shot while preserving the appearance of Imaginary God-chan, the motion of the skateboard, and the museum space✨

Even as the shapes of the paint keep changing one after another, please pay attention to how it remains connected as a single world🎨
This was created using CapCut’s AI feature “Seedance 2.5”٩( ᐛ )و
@capcutapp
---
